subject: Cannot log in to account
description: I have been unable to log in for 2 days. The login page accepts my credentials but then just redirects me back to the login page. I've tried resetting my password and it still doesn't work.

subject: App crashes on startup
description: Every time I open the mobile app it crashes within 5 seconds. Tried reinstalling but the issue persists. iPhone 15 iOS 17.2

subject: Very slow loading times
description: Pages are taking 15-20 seconds to load. This started about a week ago. My internet connection is fine.

subject: Search not returning correct results
description: When I search for my notes the results are completely wrong. It finds unrelated notes and misses the ones I'm looking for.

subject: Login failure on mobile
description: Mobile app login is broken. Desktop works fine but mobile just shows an error after entering credentials.

subject: Can't access workspace after login
description: I can log in but then get a blank screen where my workspace should be. Refreshing doesn't help.

subject: Extremely slow performance
description: Everything in the app is sluggish. Typing in notes has noticeable lag. This makes the app almost unusable.

subject: App not loading on Android
description: Android app just shows a loading spinner and never finishes loading. This started yesterday.

subject: Sync not working
description: My notes aren't syncing between my phone and laptop. Changes made on one device don't appear on the other.

subject: Login keeps kicking me out
description: I get logged out automatically every few minutes. Have to keep signing back in. Very disruptive.

subject: Database/page loading slowly
description: All my databases take forever to load. Some have a lot of data but they loaded fine before last week.

subject: Search feature broken
description: Search used to work great. Now it misses obvious matches and returns irrelevant results.

subject: Billing issue
description: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Please refund the duplicate charge.

subject: Integration with Slack not working
description: The Slack integration stopped posting notifications. Last worked 5 days ago.

subject: Can't export to PDF
description: Trying to export a page to PDF but it just downloads an empty file.
